commands.name: add-project
commands.description: register a project on the warren server (POST /projects)

commands.name: run
commands.description: dispatch a one-shot run against the warren server, tail events as NDJSON, and exit

options.description: per-run USD spend cap; wins over the agent's own and the project default

commands.name: init
commands.description: scaffold a .warren/ directory (triggers.yaml + config.yaml) in a project repo

options.description: target a registered project by id (writes into its warren clone)
target a directory on disk (defaults to process.cwd())
pin defaults.defaultRole to this registered agent

commands.name: config
commands.description: .warren/ admin tools

commands.name: config migrate
commands.description: convert legacy .warren/defaults.json into the warren-5840 YAML layout (config.yaml + preview.yaml)

options.description: target a registered project by id (writes into its warren clone)
target a directory on disk (defaults to process.cwd())

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: check the client's view of a warren server (reachable? auth valid? version match?)

options.description: run the deployment-side checks instead (env vars, burrow socket, bwrap, DB)
skip the auth check (loopback dev mode)
print raw probe/driver output (withheld from check messages) to stderr

commands.name: db
commands.description: database admin tools

commands.name: db migrate-to-postgres
commands.description: one-shot copy of a SQLite warren.db into a Postgres database

options.description: source SQLite path or URL (bare path, sqlite://, file://, :memory:)

commands.name: plan
commands.description: dispatch and steer cloud plan-runs

commands.name: plan run
commands.description: dispatch a serial plan-run against a remote warren and tail events as NDJSON

options.description: git ref to clone child workspaces from
per-child USD spend cap applied to every child dispatch
dispatch and exit without tailing events

commands.name: plan cancel
commands.description: cancel a remote plan-run and its in-flight child run

commands.name: plan status
commands.description: render a plan-run's child-state table with per-child cost + duration

commands.name: plan list
commands.description: list plan-runs, optionally filtered by project / state

commands.name: show
commands.description: render a run's detail (GET /runs/:id; json mode is the raw run document)

commands.name: wait
commands.description: poll a run to its terminal state (SDK waitForRun; exit 0 on succeeded)

commands.name: tail
commands.description: stream a run's events (GET /runs/:id/events; SIGINT detaches, exit 130)

options.description: drain the current backlog and exit instead of following
replay only events after this seq

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: cancel a non-terminal run (POST /runs/:id/cancel; idempotent)

options.description: operator note recorded on the cancel

commands.name: login
commands.description: verify a base URL + token against the server and persist them to the client config

commands.name: prime
commands.description: emit agent session context: command reference, env contract, exit codes, workflows

commands.name: serve
commands.description: start the HTTP server (default in docker entrypoint)

env.name: WARREN_API_TOKEN
env.summary: bearer token for the server (required unless WARREN_AUTH=public)

env.name: WARREN_CLIENT_CONFIG
env.summary: override the client config path (default ~/.warren/client.json, written by `warren login`)

exitCodes.name: run-failed
exitCodes.summary: the dispatched run/plan-run reached a non-success terminal state, or the command failed for any other reason

exitCodes.name: usage-error
exitCodes.summary: bad flags or arguments (missing required option, invalid --output value, validation error)

exitCodes.name: server-unreachable
exitCodes.summary: the warren server did not answer the pre-flight probe

exitCodes.name: auth-rejected
exitCodes.summary: the server rejected the bearer token (HTTP 401/403)

exitCodes.name: sigint-detach
exitCodes.summary: operator detached a live event tail with SIGINT; the remote run keeps going

workflows.name: dispatch-and-wait
steps: warren login --url <base> --token <t>   # once; stores credentials in the client config
warren run <agent> <project-id> -p "<prompt>"   # dispatch, tail NDJSON events, exit with the terminal state

workflows.name: tail-and-steer
steps: warren run <agent> <project-id> -p "<prompt>"   # each NDJSON line is one event
Ctrl-C detaches the tail (exit 130); the remote run keeps going

workflows.name: plan-run
steps: warren plan run <plan-id> --project <id> --agent <name>   # serial children, each gated on the previous PR merging
warren plan status <plan-run-id>   # child-state table with per-child cost + duration
warren plan cancel <plan-run-id>   # cancel the plan-run and its in-flight child
